entity.summary: The Las Vegas Grand Prix is a Formula 1 night race held on a temporary street circuit on the Las Vegas Strip, running 50 laps of the 6.201-km Las Vegas Strip Circuit. It makes money mainly through ticket and hospitality sales, which F1 keeps as promoter, along with sponsorship from partners such as the LVCVA, Heineken and Paramount+.

summary.headline: With 100,000+ fans a day arriving Thursday and the race locked in through 2037, Las Vegas can use this weekend to start the 2027 buyer list, track sponsor results and sell merch, on its own data.
bullets: F1 extended the Las Vegas Grand Prix through 2037 (June 4), and the LVCVA approved a $100M, 10-year sponsorship. Fixed race-week assets now pay off over a decade.

Race weekend runs Nov 19-21, with 100,000+ visitors expected each day. Premium hospitality and GA are reported sold out, Rocket Mortgage and Redfin debut on Sphere and trackside, and Apple TV streams the race free in the U.S.

Revenue beyond race night is growing. The F1 Hub at The Venetian opened Nov 7, the 2027 race is set for Nov 18-20, and Grand Prix Plaza reopens Jan 8, 2027 with new attractions while Q3 Plaza rental income dipped to $6M from $7M.

signals.title: F1 extends Las Vegas Grand Prix through 2037
signals.summary: Formula 1 announced a 10-year extension on June 4, 2026, keeping the race in Las Vegas through 2037. Clark County's commission unanimously approved a resolution on May 19, and the race stays in its November slot the week before Thanksgiving. Organizers committed to smoother setup and teardown.

signals.title: LVCVA approves $100M, 10-year sponsorship of the race
signals.summary: The LVCVA board approved a sponsorship committing $100 million over 10 years: $10 million a year through 2037, plus about $2.5 million in ticket purchases, covering the 2028-2037 races. The LVCVA is also paying F1 $10 million for the 2026 race and the 2027 edition.

signals.title: Rocket Mortgage and Redfin join as three-year partners
signals.summary: Announced Nov 16, Rocket Companies' three-year partnership brings Rocket Mortgage and Redfin to the race as its first homeownership partners. They appear Nov 19-21 on trackside signage along the 3.8-mile circuit and on Sphere's Exosphere and LED displays.

signals.title: Zoox named Official Autonomous Ride Hail Partner
signals.summary: Zoox announced a multi-year partnership on Nov 5 and will run race-week activations across Las Vegas. Starting in 2027, it plans robotaxi rides to and from Grand Prix Plaza with a dedicated pickup and drop-off zone.

signals.title: F1 Business Summit on Nov 19 with Standard Chartered and SPORT BEACH
signals.summary: The F1 Business Summit takes place Nov 19, 2026 at Caesars Palace (The Colosseum), hosted by Heather McMahan. Standard Chartered is Presenting Partner, apparently a renewal since it was also the 2025 presenting partner. SPORT BEACH is a new partner presenting the keynote panel and roundtables, and a Post-Summit Social is at F1 Arcade.

signals.title: Insight Enterprises becomes Official Event Partner
signals.summary: On Oct 19 Insight Enterprises signed on as official Technology Lifecycle Management Partner. The deal gives it a platform for premium experiences that bring clients, partners and Insight leaders together.

signals.title: SBI Holdings signs Official Presenting Partner deal in media category
signals.summary: SBI Holdings signed a sponsorship agreement around June 2026 to become Official Presenting Partner in the Media Category, as part of its SBI Neo-Media Ecosystem strategy. It falls outside the 90-day window.

signals.title: The Venetian signs five-year Founding Partner deal through 2030
signals.summary: Announced May 13, the Venetian's five-year Founding Partner agreement runs through 2030. It welcomes BWT Alpine F1 Team back for a fourth consecutive year as official home base. It again partners with Vibee (founded by Live Nation) on T-Mobile Zone ticket-and-hotel packages.

signals.title: Apple TV streams the race free in the U.S., with Univision simulcast
signals.summary: F1 has a five-year deal making Apple the exclusive U.S. broadcast partner from 2026, replacing ESPN. Apple TV streams the whole Las Vegas weekend free with no subscription needed, and Univision simulcasts with Spanish pre- and post-race programming. A creator-led altcast hosted by Michelle Khare and Justin Bell is described, but the platform was not confirmed. Apple TV is also teaming with Grindin Coffee for Strip activations.

signals.title: Qualcomm Snapdragon campaign with Kimi Antonelli timed to the race
signals.summary: The campaign is timed to the Nov. 21 race. It runs on F1 broadcasts outside the U.S. on Sky, on digital, and on channels including Sports Illustrated and YouTube. Apple TV exclusivity keeps brands like Snapdragon from running traditional U.S. broadcast ads around the race, and Qualcomm's CMO said creators are involved.

signals.title: Teams and brands release Las Vegas special liveries and kits
signals.summary: Aston Martin will run a special AMR26 livery for the weekend, also on its garage and Lance Stroll's helmet, with CoreWeave tied in. Ferrari released images of a black-and-yellow Las Vegas kit. adidas Motorsport released 'Neon Lights' and 'After Hours' fan collections for Mercedes and Audi, priced $30 to $200.

signals.title: 2026 ticket on-sale: Flamingo GA from $50 single-day and $492 three-day
signals.summary: Public sales opened May 7 at 10 a.m. PDT, following an American Express presale on May 5. Flamingo GA started at $50 single-day (practice) and $492 for three days, versus $150 for single-day GA in 2024. The $50 tier later sold out, and single-day GA went on sale Aug. 13 from $81. T-Mobile GA starts at $809, and payment plans ran through Sept 15.

signals.title: Grandstand and hospitality pricing, including new Turn 3 Grandstand
signals.summary: The new Turn 3 Grandstand starts at $1,329. Other grandstands run from $925 (Heineken) to $2,051 (Heineken Silver Main). Hospitality runs from Club Paris at $2,542 to Gordon Ramsay at F1 Garage at $28,885 and Wynn Grid Club at $25,997. The Grand Prix Trio package returns from $3,178.

signals.title: Premium inventory reported sold out; Liberty says ticket revenue pacing ahead
signals.summary: BVM Sports reports the Paddock Club, Wynn Grid Club and Gordon Ramsay at F1 Garage are sold out, and the official pages show Gordon Ramsay and Trackside Tavern sold out. The official site four days ago listed General Admission and the Grand Prix Trio as sold out, and management said ticket revenue including hospitality is pacing ahead. A no-fee offer on GA and grandstand tickets ran through Nov. 2. No official sell-out statement was found.

signals.title: F1 Hub presented by American Express opens at The Venetian with 2026 merchandise
signals.summary: The 2026 collections were announced Oct 20, and the two-floor hub in the Grand Canal Shoppes opened Nov 7. New collections come from Etai LA, Greg Yuna and Off Season, with returning Disney, BAPE, LEGO, Vegas Golden Knights and F1 Academy x Hello Kitty and Friends. It also has an LVGP Collection, a Headwear Customization Lab and an Amex Card Member Area. A Hello Kitty Cafe Pit Stop and F1 Academy-Hello Kitty fan activations were also announced.

signals.title: Official online store and team merchandise pricing
signals.summary: The official store sells the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix collection, with the Suit Turn Half-Zip Hoodie at $125, Varsity Jacket $500, Adjustable Hat $55 and Chip Stack T-Shirt $55. It also lists Topps NOW cards and Puma apparel. The F1 US Store lists Puma tees at $51.50 and Ferrari replica jackets at $285, and Mercedes lists a Las Vegas cap at £45 and hoody at £85.

signals.title: Race weekend Nov 19-21 with Saturday 8 p.m. race
signals.summary: The weekend runs Thursday Nov 19 to Saturday Nov 21. The F1 Academy reverse-grid race is Friday Nov 20 and its feature race Saturday 4:20-4:55 p.m. The drivers' parade is 6-6:30 p.m., the Grand Prix starts at 8 p.m., and gates close at 11 p.m.

signals.title: Concert and stage lineups across T-Mobile and Heineken stages
signals.summary: The T-Mobile Stage at Sphere features Two Friends and Ja Rule, Disclosure and Gorgon City, and Sean Paul and Natasha Bedingfield. The Heineken Stage has the Australian Bee Gees, Icona Pop, Eli & Fur, Disco Dom and LP Giobbi, with live Q&As with all 22 drivers. Steve Aoki and MORTEN perform pre-race and Jordin Sparks sings the anthem.

signals.title: Official F1 Afterparty with Backstreet Boys at Sphere
signals.summary: The Backstreet Boys perform at Sphere on Saturday Nov. 21 from 11:30 p.m. to 1 a.m. Sources conflict on access: one says a race ticket plus a separate afterparty ticket is needed, another says standalone tickets are public. Existing ticketholders can buy an add-on from $116.

signals.title: 2026 access changes: connected zones, single-day hospitality, hospitality deposits
signals.summary: The East Harmon, Koval and West Harmon zones are connected for eligible ticket holders. Single-day tickets return, select single-day hospitality is new, and hospitality deposits are new. CEO Emily Prazer said the West Harmon connection expands access for Lewis Hamilton Grandstand ticketholders, and one outlet frames the updates as a reaction to fan-access complaints.

signals.title: Off-track fan hubs and activations across the Strip
signals.summary: The Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS Fan Hub is at Bellagio Drive Nov 18-21, and the Atlassian Williams Fan Zone is at New York-New York, both advertised as complimentary. Wynn runs a Racing Motors Lounge with a Red Bull Pit Stop Challenge plus a merchandise pop-up Nov 18-22. The Venetian hosts BWT Alpine, and MGM and Fontainebleau offer F1-themed programming. The Williams 'Duracell Fan Prix' tour runs in Nevada Nov 16-20.

signals.title: Grand Prix Plaza: year-round attraction, closed until Jan 8, 2027
signals.summary: Plaza reopened Jan 30, 2026 with a redesigned F1 Drive karting track and an upgraded F1 X 4D theater. It sits within a 39-acre complex with 100,000+ sq ft of attractions and a 71,000 sq ft rooftop event space. Karting is $99 per driver ($79 locals/military). Public operations ended in early November and it reopens Jan 8, 2027 with Kids Karts, an indoor playground, a Cool Down Room and three new private event spaces.

signals.title: Liberty Media Q3 2026: F1 revenue up 28%, Las Vegas demand cited
signals.summary: F1 Q3 revenue rose 28% to $1,115 million, with one more race, and Adjusted OIBDA rose 44% to $338 million. Other F1 revenue grew on hospitality, licensing and Grand Prix Plaza activity, while Plaza rental income was $6 million in Q3 against $7 million a year earlier. Management said Las Vegas ticket revenue including hospitality is pacing ahead.
signals.scale: F1 Q3 revenue $1,115M; Plaza rental income $6M

signals.title: Attendance expectations and economic impact claims
signals.summary: The 2026 race anticipates over 100,000 visitors each day, and another outlet cites about 300,000 over the weekend. Past weekends reached 306,000 guests with 175,000 from out of state or abroad spending about $2,400 each. Three-year impact is $3.2 billion and $43 million in tax revenue; no official 2026 attendance target was found.

signals.title: Owned app with Ticketmaster login and all-digital tickets
signals.summary: The official F1 Las Vegas app (rated 4.8 on 1.9K ratings) handles tickets, wayfinding, partner perks and a Grand Prix Plaza mode switcher. Ticketholders sign in via Ticketmaster Account Manager. All 2026 tickets are digital, screenshots are not accepted, and gates open daily at 2:30 p.m. with re-entry until 7 p.m. No loyalty program or CRM vendor was found.

signals.title: Deposits and American Express presales drive first-party data capture
signals.summary: Fans could place a deposit through April 30 for priority access and waived fees, held in their Ticketmaster Account Manager. American Express gave Card Members a 48-hour presale from May 5 and a second presale Aug. 11-13. The sign-up form collects email and SMS opt-ins.

signals.title: 100-days-out activation, in-app Limited Drop sweepstakes and $100K community giveaway
signals.summary: A 20-minute in-app sweepstakes on Aug. 13 gave one winner two three-day Skybox tickets, flights and a Venetian stay. On Aug 15 Grand Prix Plaza hosted a 100-vehicle car show, a 15-foot slot machine and F1 Academy appearances with Bellagio, Fontainebleau and Venetian activations, per a trade blog. A $100K for 100 days community giveaway was also announced.

signals.title: LVCVA 'Pack for Vegas' campaign and influencer promotion
signals.summary: In May 2026 R&R Partners launched 'Pack for Vegas' for the LVCVA: six 15-second spots directed by Jody Hill, running across the NBA Playoffs, NBA Finals, WNBA All-Star game and Big Brother premiere. It is a summer destination campaign, not race-specific. The LVCVA has also used influencers to promote race weekend, including Hannah Stocking, per a January 2026 Las Vegas Sun report.

signals.title: Ticketing friction: app bugs, deposit complaints and queues
signals.summary: Google Play reviews cite crashes and a non-refundable $100 deposit with no ticket purchase, and the operator's May 3, 2026 reply acknowledged trouble applying deposits. Tickethold and reader comments report long queues, a 2,000+ early-bird queue and presale frustrations, though some of these sources are undated or older.

signals.title: Legal and local-friction items: settlement, lawsuits, construction and hotel rates
signals.summary: The race and its parent agreed to pay over $3 million to settle a class action over the 2023 water valve cover incident. Business owners have sued over accessibility losses and F1 covered a $40 million repaving bill. Dismantling starts Nov. 22 and runs more than a month, and a Nov 12 survey of 11 hotels averaged $118 a night, up 14.6% since Sept. 27, while one analyst said occupancy was down 8 to 18 percentage points per night.
signals.scale: $3M+ settlement; $40M repaving bill; $118 average hotel rate
